# Analysis of Transaction Net Amounts

I need to identify all transactions between May 26, 2024 and July 17, 2024 (inclusive), and calculate each customer's net amount in USD.

## Key Rules Applied:
- Date range: 2024-05-26 to 2024-07-17
- Status "paid"/"PAID"/"settled" = ADD
- Status "refunded"/"REFUND"/"chargeback" = SUBTRACT  
- Status "pending"/"on hold" = IGNORE
- EUR amounts converted at 1.069 USD per EUR
- Use last occurrence when ID appears multiple times
